description: Land Title Settlement Department - Welegoda West, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820025 (23/55028)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and the registration of land titles. It contains detailed schedules with cadastral information, parcel numbers, land extents, and references to the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land ownership, title registration, and property transfers through inheritance processes.
